subject: libblas.so.3gf error in deploy to shinyapps.io

messages.author: 0581bfa66e668254
messages.subject: libblas.so.3gf error in deploy to shinyapps.io
parts:
Hello, after viewing the shinyapps.io webinar earlier today, I decided to try deploying a simple Shiny application created from the RStudio IDE (i.e. when I create a new project, I selected a Shiny application and used the default ui.R and server.R files).  I went through the steps of authenticating my account and everything seemed fine.  But when I go to access the application (direct link https://rpodcast.shinyapps.io/shiny_test/ ) , I see this error:

/usr/lib/R/bin/exec/R: error while loading shared libraries: libblas.so.3gf: cannot open shared object file: Error 28

I went to my shinyapps.io account and retrieved the log:

2015-03-04T19:39:29.494010+00:00 shinyapps[34090]: /usr/lib/R/bin/exec/R: error while loading shared libraries: libblas.so.3gf: cannot open shared object file: Error 28
2015-03-04T19:39:32.577615+00:00 shinyapps[34090]: /usr/lib/R/bin/exec/R: error while loading shared libraries: libblas.so.3gf: cannot open shared object file: Error 28
2015-03-04T19:40:02.931415+00:00 shinyapps[34090]: /usr/lib/R/bin/exec/R: error while loading shared libraries: libblas.so.3gf: cannot open shared object file: Error 28

Again I made no modifcations at all to the application's ui.R or server.R files.  Any ideas how to fix this error?  FWIW the application runs just fine locally within RStudio.

messages.author: 0581bfa66e668254
messages.subject: Re: libblas.so.3gf error in deploy to shinyapps.io
parts: This is interesting.  I left the app idle  (it went to sleep mode according to the dashboard) and when I browsed the app again (hence making it active) now it works just fine.  I'm still puzzled why it gave the libblas.so.3gf missing error in the beginning but now it seemed to fix itself?
